title: OpenStax IA 2e Try It 9.120: sketch key features via CTS
stem_student: The equation is given in standard form: f(x) = x^2 − 8x + 12. Complete the square. From the vertex form, name the vertex, the axis of symmetry, and whether the graph has a maximum or a minimum. Sketch those key features. Do not list intervals where the function is positive, negative, increasing, or decreasing.
stem_teacher: A2.11 light only: vertex, axis, max/min, sketch from CTS. OpenStax Try It 9.120 asks to graph by transformations; this item scopes to the brief’s light boundary. Full interval laundry list is parked.
answer: f(x) = (x − 4)^2 − 4. Vertex (4, −4). Axis x = 4. Minimum (a > 0). Sketch: parabola opening up with that vertex and axis.
answer_verification: Author-computed completing-the-square rewrite of the licensed stem: half of −8 is −4; (−4)^2 = 16; add and subtract 16; (x − 4)^2 + 12 − 16 = (x − 4)^2 − 4. Vertex/axis/max-min follow Lesson 1 inspection of that writing. OpenStax student page lists the Try It without an inline solution; Answer Key was not copied.
